info.cls_ename: Master's Program, Department of Chemical Engineering

description.describe_ch: 本課程教授半導體製造程序的基本原理，並簡要回顧固態材料與元件的相關知識。課程內容涵蓋用於工業量產的所有材料，特別是應用於積體電路（IC）和薄膜電晶體（TFTs）平板顯示的製造。學生將獲得元件與電路製造的實務知識，為未來進入產業或從事先進研究奠定基礎。
description.describe_eh: This course teaches fundamental principles of semiconductor fabrication processes. It includes short reviews of solid-state materials and devices. All materials in this course are for the mass production of industry products, especially IC and TFTs for flat panel displays. Students will gain practical knowledge in device and circuit fabrication, which opens opportunities to work in industry or advanced research.

targets.describe_en: Understand the manufacturing process and material applications of products such as ICs and TFTs

targets.describe_ch: 培養半導體元件與電路製造的實務技能
targets.describe_en: Develop practical skills in the manufacturing of semiconductor devices and circuits.
